record.title: Microduck left sole — mint TPU 41.1 x 54 x 12.9 boot shell, 2.0 mm floor, ~1.6-2.1 mm walls, zero-clearance socket for the foot cap; the robot's ground contact
record.origin_why: v0.0.2 is a parametric rebuild: every number in cad/part.py was measured off Pollen Robotics’ decimated visual mesh (CC BY-SA-NC sim asset) with cecad.meshslice intervals/segments and cecad.meshfeatures (probe scripts in out/measure/foot/); nobody has Pollen’s CAD and no physical part has been measured. v0.0.1 (kept) was the vendor mesh loaded as-is.
record.why: cad/part.py builds one valid solid (bin/cad part:microduck-sole-left) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen’s own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/sole_left.stl: p95 0.05/0.05 mm, median 0.004/0.004, bbox delta [-0.03, 0.0, -0.002] mm, 0 features to match. The report is the ledger artifact (evidence/refcheck/).
record.why_this_folder_exists: The left ground-contact of the Microduck (MJCF places sole_left once, on body ankle_left, as the contact geom). Nothing on the shelf is a TPU boot for this foot.
